comments.author: @TwoFatesOneBorder
comments.text: The population contrast is what makes the mystery land for me — about half of South Korea lives around Seoul, Busan has 3.3 million, and yet the biggest city on the entire east coast is only around 200,000 people. The Taebaek detail is the key insight: it's not the mountains' height, it's that they hug the coastline and drop straight into the sea, so the east gets short, steep rivers and no wide flood plains. Pohang only existing because of that 1968 state steel decision really proves the point.
